title: My fastapi app can't reload with my uvicorn ProactorServer

### Commit to Help

- [X] I commit to help with one of those options 👆

### Example Code

```python
class ProactorServer(uvicorn.Server):
    def run(self, sockets=None):
        loop = ProactorEventLoop()
        asyncio.set_event_loop(loop)  # since this is the default in Python 3.10, explicit selection can also be omitted
        asyncio.run(self.serve(sockets=sockets))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    config = uvicorn.Config(app=app, host="0.0.0.0", port=8000, reload=True)
    server = ProactorServer(config=config)
    server.run()
```


### Description

I used the above code so that I can use asyncio related functions in fastapi (from this issuse #6485 ), but the program now doesn't reload automatically after startup, can you help me

### Operating System

Windows

answer.body:
It seems that `ProactorEventLoop` doesn't work well with Uvicorn's reload functionality on Windows.

Instead of subclassing `uvicorn.Server`, modify your code and try to use the `WindowsSelectorEventLoopPolicy` explicitly when running with reload:

```python
import asyncio
import uvicorn
from fastapi import FastAPI

asyncio.set_event_loop_policy(asyncio.WindowsSelectorEventLoopPolicy())

app = FastAPI()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    uvicorn.run("your_app:app", host="0.0.0.0", port=8000, reload=True)
```
